gaps: Very few named NVR staff with titles appear in local press: NVR almost never issues community or appointment releases. About 1,700 local-news articles (site searches for 'Ryan Homes', 'NVR', 'NVHomes', 'Heartland Homes' since 2025 across about 60 papers in NVR markets) and HBA sites were checked.

Division presidents / division managers by market: none confirmed on a primary or press source. NVR's own title for a division head is 'Division Manager' (a Dayton, OH posting has the General Manager of Homebuilding Operations working under the Division Manager). Three division heads appear only in third-party profile aggregators and are entered as Inferred: Pete Mielnik (Lancaster, PA), Elisa Burch (West Palm Beach, FL), Doug Jones (Cleveland/Akron). No division is named with a primary source.

Division-level land leaders confirmed in 2025 press: Scott Munday (Charlotte, General Manager of Land), Tom Vaughan (Cecil County MD, General Manager of Land), Tim Lengen (Charleston SC, Entitlement Manager). Others are third-party only (TheOrg / ULI snippet): Joe Korcinsky (Nashville), John Hodson (Pittsburgh), Richard Austin (Atlanta), Joseph Viesta (New Jersey), Nicole Frambach (market not stated).

Unconfirmed leads NOT entered as rows (directory or snippet only, with no geography and no date): Eugene DiMenna (Division President, ZoomInfo snippet); Jonathan Hess (Division President on one ZoomInfo version, 'Manager, Production' in another snippet); Henry Johnsen and Thomas Sear (each 'Vice President, Division Manager' in Comparably snippets); Beth Groner (division manager, Comparably snippet); Jason Brant (Vice President at Ryan Homes since 2019-12, village.ai snippet). Comparably and village.ai pages are bot-blocked (403 / PerimeterX).

Stale names deliberately excluded: Brad Messenger (regional vice president, NVR/Ryan Homes, Maryland Eastern Shore, quoted in the Star Democrat in 2008); Alex Martin (former VP and Division Manager, Ryan Homes Washington DC, now at Mattamy, per a search snippet); Jeffrey Martchek (President of Homebuilding Operations, announced 2016, not in the 2026 proxy).

Markets where no one was found (no name at all): Washington DC metro / Northern Virginia (apart from an NVBIA board member), Baltimore, Frederick, Waldorf / Southern Maryland, Fredericksburg, Virginia Beach / Norfolk, Williamsburg, Charlottesville, Harrisonburg, Lynchburg, Roanoke, West Virginia (Martinsburg, Morgantown), Philadelphia, Lehigh Valley, Harrisburg, York, Hamilton / Voorhees / Parsippany NJ (apart from one regional land development manager), Buffalo, Rochester, Columbus, Cincinnati, Dayton, Indianapolis, Chicago, Southern Kentucky / Louisville, Raleigh, Fayetteville / Pinehurst, Wilmington NC, Greenville, Columbia, Myrtle Beach, Beaufort, North Augusta, Savannah, Jacksonville, Orlando and Tampa.

Market list source: nvrcareers.com 'Search for Jobs' lists NVR job locations by state, including manufacturing plants such as Thurmont MD, Darlington PA, Kings Mountain NC, Portland TN and Lavonia GA. The 10-K gives only states by segment and says 37 metropolitan areas.

NVR publishes no division, regional or area leadership: the FY2025 10-K, the 2026 proxy, ryanhomes.com, nvrinc.com and land.nvrinc.com name no one below the four executive officers. The 10-K and proxy only refer to 'regional and division leaders' and 'division management' in general terms.

Segment / regional leaders (Mid Atlantic, North East, Mid East, South East): not publicly disclosed. Four names appear as 'Area President' only in an undated third-party directory (kept as Inferred, geography unknown).
President of Homebuilding Operations: no current holder named in the 2026 proxy or FY2025 10-K (the role was last publicly announced in 2016); whether it still exists is not public.
Brand presidents for Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes: not publicly disclosed; the brands are trade names inside NVR, Inc., not separate subsidiaries with their own published presidents.

HBA boards checked directly with no NVR / Ryan Homes / NVHomes person listed: Maryland BIA (board and six chapters), HBA of Virginia, Coastal Virginia BIA, BIA of Northeast Ohio, HBA of Greater Cincinnati, BAGI (Indianapolis), BIA of Greater Louisville, HBA of Greater Charlotte, HBA of Raleigh-Wake County (officers), Builders Association of Metropolitan Pittsburgh (officers). HBA of Greenville lists names without companies. BIA of Central Ohio returned 403.
curl to www.sec.gov returned the 'Undeclared Automated Tool' block page; filings were read through WebFetch instead (first 100K characters of the 10-K and proxy).
